memory_candidates.content: When a plan pins Lean Challenge Statements (plan-format.md `## Lean Challenge Statements`), every `def`/`theorem` whose body is `sorry` loses any section `variable` it only used in its body: a `variable (M : TaskModel F)` consumed solely by the proof term is NOT a binder of the sorry-bodied Challenge declaration, so the Challenge and landed statements silently disagree in arity. Fix at authoring time: make such parameters explicit binders on the declaration line in BOTH the prototype and the Challenge block, keep genuinely-reducing scaffolding (`abbrev` with a real body, anonymous `instance`) unpinned, and avoid every backtick in the `**Goals**:` block except on pinned identifiers, because lean-challenge-snapshot.sh reads each backticked token there as one.
